name: browser-automation-studio.do-task
purpose: Orchestrate one browser task: recall prior attempts, rank persisted workflows, execute up to k with wait, fall back to one bounded vision-navigation, decide whether to author a candidate, and journal the attempt.

task.description: The browser task in plain words; also the navigation prompt.

scenario.description: Scenario under test; used to key site-note entries.

recurrence_threshold.description: Recalled task-record count at or above which a clean navigation recommends authoring.

workflow_ids.description: Workflow UUIDs to try first, before fit ranking.

session.description: Existing browser session id; without it the navigation fallback is skipped.

model.description: Vision model identifier, required when `session` is given (navigation fallback). Never defaulted: callers must not hardcode a model slug.

memory_scope.description: vrooli-memory scope the recall reads and the report writes. Fixtures pass fixture-bas-usage so a test run never teaches the live scope.

recurrence_similarity.description: Recall score floor a prior task-record must clear to count toward recurrence.

nav_max_tokens.description: Token ceiling for the navigation fallback; over it the outcome is budget.

assumptions: browser-automation-studio is running; vrooli-memory is optional (degraded to memory_unavailable)
the caller may execute every candidate workflow; mutating workflows carry their own confirmation labels
workflows/create has no governed binding, so authoring is recommended in the envelope and persisted by hand
lib.<name>() takes no arguments today, so the smoke logic is inlined rather than called
lib.<name>() accepts no inputs today; smoke-flow and find-flows logic is inlined until program-runtime lands lib.<scenario>.<name>(input=...) (W1).
invariants: at most k executions and at most one navigation are started; no retry
no binding with effect destructive is called; nothing is persisted
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path
Memory is written only in report, only when the act phase was entered and the status is ok, partial, or failed; a rejected input, an unreachable driver, and a refusal write nothing.
Memory is written only to the scope named by the memory_scope input.

signals.prior_attempts: recalled task-record entries for this task
signals.candidates: up to k of {id, name, folder, overlap, fit(explicit|strong|weak)}
signals.attempts: one {workflow_id, execution_id, execution_status, outcome, class, detail} per execution tried
signals.passed_workflow_id: the first workflow that completed, or null
signals.navigation: {navigation_id, status, outcome, step_count} when the fallback ran, else null
signals.author_recommended: true when recurrence >= threshold and the navigation reached the goal
signals.author_reason: why authoring is or is not recommended
signals.memory_writes: counts of journal notes written per kind
signals.memory_written: True when at least one entry was journaled this run.
signals.memory_skipped_reason: Why no entry was journaled, when none was.

outputs.evidence: execution:<id> per attempt, navigation:<id> when the fallback ran

budget.async_reason: wall_ms exceeds the 120 s synchronous bound: submit with --async and wait once.

memory.writes_when: phase act was entered and status is ok, partial, or failed

fixtures.note: No workflow id is pinned: candidates are discovered from workflows list on the host running the fixture.
A rejected input must teach the scope nothing; this fixture is the regression for that guard.
